Die 537 eingeweihte Basilika Hagia Sophia in Istanbul ist ein architektonisches Meisterwerk mit wechselvoller Geschichte. Eintausend Jahre lang war sie die größte Kirche der Welt und das religiöse und symbolische Zentrum des ersten großen christlichen Reiches. Bis zur Eroberung Konstantinopels war die Hagia Sophia das größte Gotteshaus der Christenheit. Nach der Eroberung Konstantinopels 1453 wandelten sie die Osmanen in eine Moschee um und fügten als äußeres Kennzeichen vier Minarette hinzu.

After her would-be-husband runs away from his wedding, abandoned bride Megha faces up to her heartbreak as she sets out on a journey of self-discovery whilst trying to navigate a judgemental society.
Durga is out to avenge the crimes committed by Shaurya, a playboy and the scion of the powerful Goenka family of Kolkata.
The responsible son of a middle-class family crosses paths with the arrogant daughter of a wealthy businessman, leading to the lives of Ramachari and Charu forever being changed.
Three aspiring singers from Punjab overcome various obstacles and follow their passion to contest in a reality music show.
The partners begin to retaliate after Ankita Lokhande and Vicky Jain lay claim to victory, and Sonam Bajwa and Ammy Virk visit to encourage the couples.

Vanessa soll an Boyds Schule zu Halloween für eine tolle Party sorgen. Sie wird richtig kreativ und geht in der Gestaltung einer Spuklandschaft richtig auf. Doch als Boyd das Gelände testet, wird schnell klar, dass Vanessa zu weit gegangen ist.

Mike wird verdächtigt, Werbeplakate seines Nachbarn für die Wahl ins Schulamt gestohlen zu haben. Der Verdacht ist gar nicht so weit hergeholt: Es ist allgemein bekannt, dass Mike ihn nicht ausstehen kann. Eve wird von einem Jungen umworben.

Als die Schüler anfangen, bei einem neuen Online-Trend mitzumachen, der in der Schule für Unruhe sorgt, tut sich das Lehrerkollegium zusammen, um dem ein Ende zu bereiten. Mr. Johnson gibt Gregory tröstende Lebensratschläge.

Am "Ders Day" gehen die Jungs ins Museum und sorgen dort für jede Menge Ärger. Blake und Adam versuchen sich außerdem an einem Raubzug, während Ders weiterhin für Chaos und Verwirrung im Museum sorgt, doch es geht nach hinten los.
Adam, Blake und Ders kommen auf die irre Idee, ein Spielkasino in ihrem Haus zu eröffnen.

Stan Lee heuert einen neuen Superhelden an, während ein Mann seine Glaubwürdigkeit verliert. Denn er leidet an einem Hirnfrost. Außerdem entwirft ein Mann eine komplexe Gedächtnisstütze, um sich an sein geparktes Auto zu erinnern.

Die Busfahrerin Mrs. Crabtree verursacht einen Verkehrsunfall mit dem Schulbus und muss Hilfe holen. Sie wird aber abgelenkt und in der Zwischenzeit erinnern sich die Jungs an ihr bisheriges Leben und was ihnen alles zugestoßen ist.

Das Sundance Filmfestival zieht nach South Park und es kommt zum Konflikt mit den Filmleuten. Ihre Ernährung belastet das Kanalsystem und droht Mr. Hankey zu töten. Nur Chefkoch kann ihn noch retten, damit dieser dem Festival ein Ende bereitet.

Jeff muss heute einen Sexpartner finden, um die Zerstörung der Erde durch Aliens zu verhindern. Ein Arzt macht zudem Zaubertricks, während er Geburtshilfe leistet. Bethiffer ist mit einem Virtual-Reality-Spiel beschäftigt.

Ein Autoverkäufer ist gewillt, alles zu tun, um Autos zu verkaufen. Wirklich alles. Gary befindet sich auf einem Pfadfinderausflug, wo ihm üble Streiche gespielt werden. Ein bewaffneter Hausbesitzer bedroht den Osterhasen.

Mark Lilly ist Sozialarbeiter in New York und muss sich mit Kürzungen in seiner Abteilung auseinandersetzen. Außerdem muss er auch seinem Zombie-Mitbewohner und seiner Dämonen-Freundin helfen, sich an das Leben in der Stadt anzupassen.

Diesmal wird das Konzept der Wohltätigkeit durchleuchtet und in seinem Kern hinterfragt. Viele Leute geben, ob bewusst oder unbewusst, in Wirklichkeit nur deswegen etwas ab, weil sie sich dadurch besser fühlen und angesehen werden.

Läuse-Alarm an der Grundschule von South Park! Die Schulleitung versucht, den Namen des Kindes zu schützen, damit es nicht den dann folgenden Hänseleien ausgesetzt ist. Für Cartman und Co. macht dieser Schutz der Obrigkeit die Suche nach dem Namen natürlich besonders attraktiv und so versuchen sie, den "Täter" über fragwürdige Tests zu entlarven.

Bei einer Live-Übertragung im Fernsehen begeht Stans Vater den folgenschweren Fehler, das N-Wort zu sagen - und das, obwohl er kein Rassist ist. Trotzdem wird er von allen in South Park mit großer Verachtung gestraft und auch Stan bekommt sein Fett weg.

Cartman übernachtet oft bei Butters. Sein neues Hobby ist es, peinliche Fotos vom schlafenden Butters zu machen. Als er ein Bild von sich mit Butters' Glied im Mund macht, warnen ihn seine Freunde, dass das Bild auch für Cartman peinlich sein kann.

In Zeiten, in denen der Terrorismus allgegenwärtig scheint, muss ein wachsamer Bürger wie Cartman sofort stutzig werden, wenn ein muslimischer Junge nach South Park zieht. Und so beginnt er eine aufwändige Recherche, die zum Ergebnis hat, das offenbar tatsächlich ein Anschlag für den Besuch von Hillary Clinton in South Park geplant ist!

Ms Garrison hat echte Probleme in ihrem Sexualleben. Immer, wenn sie mal wieder einen Partner verloren hat, ist sie so frustriert, dass sie ihre Wut an den Kindern ihrer Klasse auslässt und ihnen extra viele Hausaufgaben aufgibt. Dieser Zustand ändert sich grundlegend, als Ms Garrison in einer Lesbenbar ihre Gefühle für das eigene Geschlecht entdeckt. Blöd nur, dass die Bar demnächst von ein paar Persern gekauft werden soll.

Cartman entdeckt die Vorzüge des Tourette-Syndroms, bei dem die Betroffenen unkontrolliert fluchen. So nimmt er das Syndrom als Freibrief, in der Schule als Simulant alle möglichen Schimpfworte vor sich her zu brüllen. Als er merkt, dass man ihm die Show abnimmt, beschließt Cartman, berühmt zu werden und lädt ein TV-Team nach South Park ein, das eine Reportage über ihn drehen soll.

Die Kids wollen sich an ihrem Vertrauenslehrer rächen, doch lernen dabei eine Lektion. Denn Rache zu nehmen kann gefährlich werden. Bei den Kids endet es in einem riesigen Geschwisterstreit. Teddy lädt zu einem Papierflieger-Wettbewerb ein.

Die Quiltnäherin Edith zieht Bob in ihren Racheplan rein, worauf er sie in der Stadt herumfährt. Die Kinder feiern eine Gatsby-Geburtstagsparty. Linda leistet großen Einsatz, Teddy zu helfen, seinen Geschmackssinn zu erweitern.

Die Belchers möchten einem Truthahn das Leben retten, der im Schlachthaus landen soll. Aber als ein Reporter davon erfährt, entwickelt sich ihre selbstlose Tat zu einer Rettungsaktion mit vielen verzwickten Hindernissen.

Gene ist außer sich vor Wut. Alex lässt ihn einfach im Stich, nur damit er der Rollkunstlaufpartner von Courtney sein kann. Teddy, Linda und Bob malen sich die schlimmsten Geschichten aus, als sie herausfinden, dass jemand das Restaurant observiert.

Tina erfindet gemeinsam mit ihrer Forschungsprojektpartnerin ein neues Gerät. Darüber können sie mit Aliens kommunizieren. Als sie eine Warnbotschaft erhalten, bekommen die beiden große Angst. Bob möchte Mini-Garderobenständer verkaufen.

Stan engagiert sich als Politesse, um wieder ernster genommen zu werden. Plötzlich erhält er tatsächlich die besten Plätze in Restaurants, was Francine in hohem Maße beeindruckt. Unterdessen posiert Hayley nackt für einen Kunstkurs am College und ist stark verwundert, als sie dort auf Roger trifft.

Stan betet zu Gott, um einen Freund gesendet zu kriegen. Der neue Begleiter scheint aber ein Atheist zu sein. Aus diesem Grund versucht Stan, seinem neuen Freund ein bisschen Gottesfurcht einzuflößen, mit dramatischen Folgen. Unterdessen überzeugt Roger Steve davon, dass letzterer in Hogwarts angenommen wurde.

Stan kommt von einer weiteren, gefährlichen Mission nach Hause und muss feststellen, dass seine Familie das Weihnachtsfest alles andere als konservativ begehen will. Als erste Gegenmaßnahme beschließt er, alle zur Suche nach einem besonderen Baum mit in den Wald zu nehmen, allerdings mit katastrophalen Folgen.

Stan und seine Familie stellen die Charaktere von James Bond in einem Remake dar. Dabei muss Stan als Top-Agent den fiesen Tearjerker, der von Roger gespielt wird und die Erde durch diabolische Filme, die töten können, unsicher macht, stoppen.
Als Ida Dewey vor einem Unfall retten möchte, verliert sie selbst ein Bein. Hal schenkt Dewey einen Hund, der mit dem Bein verschwindet.

Den geliebten Schulschwänztag haben Malcolm und Reese leider verpasst, sie sind verärgert und beschließen, es ihren Mitschülern heimzuzahlen. Dewey lädt Chad nach Hause ein, aber Hal ist davon gar nicht begeistert. Trotzdem gestattet Lois es.

Reese nimmt einen Job als Kammerjäger an. Dabei entdeckt er seine Vorliebe für Raupen, um die er sich fortan liebevoll kümmert. Indes versucht Malcolm verzweifelt, das Herz einer Arbeitskollegin zu gewinnen.

Malcolm ist überdurchschnittlich intelligent - und seine Familie alles andere als normal. Zwischen seinen ausgeflippten Eltern und völlig verrückten Brüdern erlebt er den ganz normalen Wahnsinn im Alltag einer durchschnittlichen US-Familie.

Phil und Claire planen eine kinderfreie Woche, da Luke, Haley und Alex mit ihren sommerlichen Aktivitäten beschäftigt sind. Cam und Mitch verbringen viel Zeit miteinander: Sie feiern die Entscheidung des Obersten Gerichtshofs.

Lukes und Mannys erster Schultag gestaltet sich für Phil und Gloria schwerer als für die beiden Jungs. Währenddessen tritt Claire in Jays Firma wieder in die Arbeitswelt ein und muss am ersten Tag noch einigen Rost abschütteln.

Als Cams Schwester zu Besuch kommt, findet er einen Weg, seine Verlobung bekannt zu geben. Phil und Claire entscheiden, nicht bei einem von Lukes Spielen dabei zu sein. Gloria weigert sich, eine Brille zu tragen.
Die Erwachsenen wollen ein neues Restaurant besuchen, verpassen jedoch fast den reservierten Termin, den Jay mit Mühe und Not organisiert hat.

Professor Farnsworth "klont" nach einem Absturz die tote Crew wieder zum Leben. Nur Leela liegt weiterhin im Koma, weshalb Fry sich einen Leela-Bot baut, der genauso aussieht wie sie. Als sie tatsächlich aufwacht, ist die Verwirrung perfekt.

Bei einem Angelausflug wird das Raumschiff von einem riesigen Fisch in die Tiefe gezogen. Unter Wasser entdecken die Freunde die Stadt Atlanta, die von Meerjungfrauen bewohnt wird. Fry verliebt sich sofort, doch diese Liebe hat keine Zukunft.

Die Crew entdeckt eine unwiderstehliche Speise, die "Popplers", auf einem neuen Planeten. "Poppler" setzen sich schnell auf der Erde durch. Doch dann stellt sich heraus, dass es sich bei den "Popplers" um kleine Lebewesen handelt.

Mum erhält zum Muttertag Geschenke von allen Robotern, die in der Fabrik entstanden sind. Doch eigentlich mag sie den Tag nicht. In diesem Jahr ist sie besonders schlecht gelaunt, denn sie wird an eine einstige Liebe erinnert.

Die Freunde lassen sich von Professor Farnsworths "Was wäre, wenn"-Maschine zu Exkursen in ihre Leben verführen. Bender findet heraus, was wäre, wenn er 150 Meter groß wäre. Wäre Fry nicht eingefroren worden, hätte dies gravierende Folgen gehabt.

Weil Bender anfängt "Schlafzubiegen", nimmt er einen Job in der Biegefabrik an und trifft Angeleena. Es scheint der Beginn einer wunderbaren Romanze zu werden, doch dann trifft Bender auf Angeleenas Ex-Ehemann: seinen Erzrivalen Flexo.

Als er ein altes Spukschloss erbt, wird Bender von einem Werwolf angegriffen und verwandelt. Schockiert stellt er fest, dass er versucht, seine eigenen Freunde zu töten. Um den Fluch zu brechen, muss der Original-Werwolf besiegt werden.

Leela, Bender und Fry melden sich als Reservisten für die Armee und kurz darauf kommt es zum Krieg. Fry soll Henry Kissinger zu Friedensverhandlungen auf dem Planeten Spheron Eins begleiten, der von ballförmigen Aliens bewohnt wird.

Nachdem die gesamte Crew seinetwegen gefeuert wurde, tauschen Fry und Leela ihre Karrierechips. Leela liefert daraufhin Pizzas aus und Fry arbeitet als Tiefkühl-Berater. Dabei trifft er seine Exfreundin Michelle und landet mit ihr in Los Angeles.

Der Bruder von Daffyd Thomas outet sich als schwul, was Daffyd gar nicht gefällt. Denn er ist doch `der einzige Schwule im Dorf'. Deshalb rät er ihm, bisexuell zu werden. Anne geht in den Park, um Enten zu füttern - auf ihre Art. Vicky macht in einem Bus Ärger und sich selbst ziemlich lächerlich.

Für 10000 Pfund behauptet Vicky auf dem Polizeirevier, dass sie einen Raubüberfall bezeugen kann. Der Traumkredit eines jungen Paares wird abgelehnt. Bubbles De Vere will durch Körpereinsatz einer Zahlung entkommen. Ein Feinschmecker will Junk-Food.

Die einfachen Besatzungsmitglieder der USS Cerritos erhalten die Aufgabe, die kürzlich renovierte USS Voyager zu ihrem neuen Ziel auf der Erde zu begleiten, wo sie als Museum dienen wird. Die Herausforderung beweist sich als äußerst schwierig.

Während eine rätselhafte Macht Raumschiffe stört und den Frieden gefährdet, bleibt die Cerritos-Crew unbehelligt und konzentriert sich auf alltägliche Aufgaben wie das Ausweichen vor bösen Computern und das Feststecken in Höhlen.

Im Mittelpunkt der animierten Komödie steht eine unvollkommene Familie von Menschen, Göttern und Monstern im mythischen antiken Griechenland, die versucht, eine der ersten Städte der Welt zu regieren, ohne sich gegenseitig umzubringen.

Im Mittelpunkt der animierten Komödie steht eine unvollkommene Familie von Menschen, Göttern und Monstern im mythischen antiken Griechenland, die versucht, eine der ersten Städte der Welt zu regieren, ohne sich gegenseitig umzubringen.
Packt eure Koffer: Die Solar Opposites fahren in den Urlaub!
Die Solars leben in einer besonderen Stadt, denn die Stadt, in der sie leben, ist preisgekrönt.
Rick und Morty landen in einer verwirrenden Situation. Gemeinsam erinnern sie sich an frühere Abenteuer, was zu einer Auseinandersetzung mit einem alten Feind führt.

Rick ist erschöpft, weil immer mehr lustige, aber auch sehr merkwürdige Charaktere auftauchen. Morty drängt ihn dazu, eine Therapie zu machen und herauszufinden, warum es so viele Schurken ausgerechnet auf ihn abgesehen haben.
Wenn Rick einem nahelegt, etwas nicht zu tun, sollte man wirklich auf ihn hören. Morty weiß nicht, worauf er sich einlässt, als er ein Geschenk von einem Fremden erhält.

Während Morty gefangen ist, muss Rick alles daran setzen, um ihn wieder zu befreien. Als er sein Vorhaben in die Tat umsetzen möchte, macht Summer einen auf "Stirb langsam". Allerdings hat sie den Film noch nie zuvor gesehen.

Summer und Morty können sich absolut gar nicht von ihrer neuen ultrarealistischen Videospielkonsole trennen und sitzen voller Spannung davor. Darüber hinaus steht eines der Lieblingsfeiertage der ganzen Familie Smith an.
Jimmy Carr, GK Barry and Jamali Maddix are sniffing out potential A******s. There's a controversial psychic, someone who ended a friendship over ketchup, and some wild ex revenge.
It's Jimmy and Timmy versus Nathan and Mimsy at the upcoming science fair, but things soon go to a whole other level.

PC Principal has never faced a more challenging time in the role, and he's falling in love with the newly appointed vice-principal. Meanwhile, Kyle has an epiphany about the problems with Terrance and Phillip.
There are stranger things going on in South Park, and President Garrison seems to be the cause. Meanwhile, The White family aren't happy with the PC teachings that are happening.
Sharon is overreacting to everything these days and Randy cannot cope. Meanwhile, Cartman unexpectedly fails his maths test.
Unable to pull off this week's pickleball and coffee shop challenges, the losing Jokers are forced to participate in an overseas game show hosted by special guest Paul Scheer.

The jokers are posing as salesmen and must sell their bizarre products to focus group participants, then attempt a challenge that turns out to be a mouthful; Sal finds himself in a stinky situation in tonight's punishment with guest star Kal Penn.
Ray is devastated after discovering his family lied to him about his guest appearance on a TV sports show.
Ray reluctantly accompanies Debra to parenting classes, then discovers that he can put the skills he learns to good use with his own parents.
Ray reluctantly agrees to take Robert out on the anniversary of his divorce, but is disturbed by the 'brotherly bonding thing' that develops.
Ray wants to teach Ally not to be a quitter, so he resumes the piano lessons he dropped 25-years earlier. Then he wonders why he ever gave up in the first place.

Ray Barone's life seems perfect: he's a successful sportswriter living with his wife Debra and three kids, but trouble comes in paradise in the shape of his interfering mother, grumpy father and resentful brother. In this opening episode of the series, Debra wants a peaceful birthday with Ray, so he tells his parents and brother that there's no party: a lie with embarrassing consequences.
Debra is upset that Ray has a problem showing affection for her. Her anger is nothing, however, compared with her reaction when he shares his problem with his interfering parents.
Charlie rents Caroline's cottage to an aspiring actress.
Caroline trains Charlie for a PTA boxing match.
A work-study programme puts Joanna in Caroline's employ.
Ex-footballer Charlie Burrows leaves London with his daughter to start a new life in the country, keeping house for a female executive with a son.
The only way Sabrina can reverse a spell is to tell Roxie the truth about being a witch, and Salem induces Morgan to pamper him.
Sabrina tumbles into Wonderland, where she meets the White Rabbit (Donny Most) and the Queen of Hearts.
Sabrina uses magic to eliminate flaws from her personality, but it causes more problems. Dylan Neal guest stars.
Sabrina's bedroom turns into a circus, and she must walk a tightrope.
Two Sabrinas vie for Aaron's affection; Harvey admits to Roxie and Morgan that he's still in love with Sabrina. Six Pence None the Richer makes an appearance.
Sabrina prevents Morgan from falling down a lift shaft and incurs the wrath of the Fates, and Sabrina doubts Aaron's sincerity when he proposes to her.
Sabrina blurts out that she loves Harvey and then uses magic to search her own heart.
Aaron nearly calls off the wedding after Sabrina consults Cinderella for advice, then transforms into a fire-breathing dragon.
Aunt Irma (guest star Barbara Eden) refuses to give her blessing for Sabrina's upcoming wedding to Aaron.

A cruise to the Bermuda Triangle leaves Sabrina without magic and the girls trying to survive a hurricane; Sabrina must convince the spirit of the Triangle that her friendship with Roxie and Morgan will survive after her marriage.
Sabrina wakes up with cold feet on her wedding day, but she hopes a little magic and words of wisdom from her mother and aunt will help.

Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) inadvertently turns Libby (Jenna Leigh Green) into a pineapple and must appeal to the Witches' Council (guest stars Penn Jillette, Teller and Deborah Harry) to reverse the spell.
Sabrina is unhappy when Libby starts spreading lies about her. She decides to use some magic to make sure everyone tells the truth, but her plan backfires.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) accidentally casts a spell on a cranky toddler, turning him into a grown man (Frank Conniff). With Caroline Rhea and Beth Broderick.
Sabrina decides to use her powers to do three good things for her friends, but interfering with the lives of mortals causes `Terrible Things' to happen.
It's Halloween, and Harvey is holding a party. Sabrina wants to go, but Zelda wants her to come to a family occasion instead. So Sabrina clones herself.
Sabrina wants Harvey to ask her to the school dance, but Libby gets in first and asks him. Sabrina's aunts offer some help with some magic man dough.
A substitute teacher turns up at school, but the teacher is actually Vesta, one of her aunts, who takes Sabrina to her luxurious home.
One of Sabrina's classmates is trying to become a magician and Sabrina helps out by becoming their assistant, but when she uses her magic, things go wrong.
Sabrina isn't impressed when Libby makes fun of a 'geek' at school - so deciding to turn the tables, Sabrina turns Libby into a geek as well.

Rachel is dating her assistant, Tag, but they must keep it a secret at work because of the company's anti-dating policy. Her friends warn her that the relationship will only cause her trouble, but just for fun, she becomes more brazen about it.
Ross finds himself looking after Ben and decides to do something special. Since all the Santa costumes have been rented out, Ross dons the holiday armadillo outfit.

Chandler and Rachel pig out on a neighbour's cheesecake that was mistakenly delivered to Chandler. They feel bad, but not quite guilty enough to refrain from eating a second one that has also been wrongly delivered.
During their first night together, Rachel and Tag realise they forgot to ship out an important package at the office.

Phoebe's new job as a telemarketer gets off to a tricky start when the first person she calls, an office worker called Earl, tells her he feels unappreciated and wants to kill himself. Phoebe keeps him on the telephone, trying to persuade him otherwise and finally takes the desperate measure of going to his office to convince him to stay alive.

Celebrating Rachel's 30th birthday inspires the friends to reminisce about their own 30th birthdays. Joey got angry with God for breaking their deal, Ross bought himself a sports car in an attempt to recapture his youth, and Monica got blind drunk and embarrassed herself at her surprise party.

Joey accidentally informs a cast member that she will be fired so that his character will get her character's brain, and Ross plans a surprise for Monica and Chandler's wedding - he wants to play the bagpipes.
Monica and Chandler fondly reminisce about London until a startling revelation leaves Chandler floored. Meanwhile, Rachel teaches Ben practical jokes to play on Ross.

The hard-nosed Detroit cop from the original film returns to Los Angeles to help solve another case. This time he must direct his efforts towards unravelling the Alphabet Crimes, a series of robberies committed by leather-jacketed punks. The investigation puts him on the trail of an illegal arms dealer and his hit lady.

Iain is joined by Guz Khan, Laura Smyth, Chloe Burrows and Hugh Davies to take down the internet's most ridiculous moments with sharp wit and savage humour.
The ageing boy band Boys 5-eva have decided to reform. It might seem like a cash-grab, and it is.
Sketches include a football player being penalised for excessive celebration, the premiere of 'Othello', and a high-school student gaining notoriety from a stolen joke.
BAFTA award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre returns with his Big Show, featuring Hollywood star Michael Sheen, Olly Murs, and music from Craig David.
There is mud, there are mushrooms and there are lots of other unsightly things waiting in the water.
One hundred new recruits face the slippy Stepping Stones and the bonkers Knock Knock.
Michael McIntyre hosts as Anita Rani, Babatunde Aleshe, Ekin-Su, Gyles Brandreth, Josh Widdicombe, Nick Knowles and Stacey Dooley try to help the contestants answer their way to a fortune.
Joey is excited about his audition for a major television action series about a man and his crime-fighting robot, but Chandler almost ruins everything.
Ross fails to impress his girlfriend's father, and Phoebe makes Chandler and Monica paranoid by chronicling their every move in a fictional book she is writing.
Ross accidentally takes Elizabeth to the same cabin where Elizabeth's strict father takes Rachel for a romantic holiday, and Monica panics Chandler by planning their wedding.

Since she is the only one who knows that Chandler plans to ask Monica to marry him, Phoebe helps Chandler shop for a wedding ring, while Rachel's wish for Paul to reveal his emotions creates a new set of problems.
Chandler's romantic marriage proposal is ruined when Monica's former boyfriend returns, Joey accidentally buys a boat, and a dormitory incident reminds Ross how young his girlfriend is.
Monica and Chandler encounter Richard (Tom Selleck), Monica's former boyfriend, in a romantic restaurant.

Everyone is toasting Chandler and Monica's engagement, but after Chandler fails to come up with the goods in the bedroom, he begins to worry about the consequences. Elsewhere, Monica thinks Rachel is trying to steal her glory when she catches her kissing Ross.

Monica's dream of a fairytale wedding fizzles out after she learns what her parents have done with her wedding fund. Meanwhile, Rachel fumes when a teasing Joey stumbles across her juicy late-night reading material.

Chandler's desperate effort to bond with Monica's dad by playing racquetball backfires when he accidentally gets too up-close-and-personal. Elsewhere, Rachel tries to teach 'landlubber' Joey how to sail without falling overboard, while Monica seeks to replicate Phoebe's late grandmother's secret recipe by deconstructing her last remaining cookie.

Rachel must hire an assistant and agonises over whether to hire an efficient, experienced woman, or sexy young Tag Jones. Ignoring her friends' advice, she hires Tag and soon regrets it. To make matters worse, Tag is attracted to Phoebe.

While taking an engagement picture for himself and Monica, Chandler can't stop pulling a strange face, Rachel enlists Joey to take Tag out for a night on the town, and Phoebe and Ross date a couple in the middle of a divorce.

Wedding fever continues when Monica can't decide whether to appoint Rachel or Phoebe as her maid of honour. To help Monica decide, Joey and Ross test them on how they would react in certain wedding situations.

Ross is elated that the university library contains his doctoral dissertation, but he is shocked to discover that it is located in a remote corner frequently used by students having sex. Elsewhere, the tables are turned on Joey when Erin is the one to just want sex and not a relationship.

Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during Thanksgiving dinner, and Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a cute dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away.
Axel Foley and his Beverly Hills buddies investigate criminal activities at a Southern California amusement park.

Twenty-two-year-old Toby Lowry murders an elderly disabled man and claims that his 15-year-old girlfriend Morgan Leppert manipulated him into the act so they could run away together.

Ahmad Arbery was out jogging when three white men assumed he was a burglar, chased him down and shot him multiple times. Cellphone video captured by Arbery's assailants proved to the jury that these men were not the heroes they claimed to be.

Kyle Rittenhouse shot and killed two people and maimed a third during a Black Lives Matter protest in Kenosha, Wisconsin. The 17-year-old, armed with an AR-15, claimed he acted in self-defence because he feared for his life.

A clown carrying balloons and a basket of flowers shot and killed Marlene Warren when she opened her front door in 1990. Even though police suspected Warren's ex-husband and his then-girlfriend, it would take decades to make an arrest.

In April 1998, 17-year-old Sylvia Fleming went missing in Omagh, Northern Ireland. Six weeks later, police discovered Sylvia's dismembered body under floorboards of a new build house in the town.

Peachtree City socialites Ruby Joyner and Halima Jones are found murdered in a van, igniting a frenzy within their wealthy community. When police dig into the women's personal lives, they uncover a secret that blows the case open.
A burnt out car and a blood-stained bedroom reveal the chilling murder of a community pillar. The smallest of clues could lead police to her heartless killer.
When a Texas police detective finds his wife dead from a gunshot wound, his fellow detectives work to uncover if her death was an accident, a suicide, or something more sinister.

Identical twin sisters are involved in a horrific crash on the island of Maui. One sister miraculously survives after their car plunges over the side of a cliff; questioning if this was a tragic accident or something more ominous.

A young woman who is lying on railroad tracks is hit by a freight train, but when her cause of death comes into question, investigators push to reopen the case; after years of dedicated police work, the buried truth finally comes to light.
On an autumn morning in 1999, a teenager vanishes from her home. Seventeen days later, her body is discovered seven miles away. It takes more than 15 years for the heartbreaking truth to emerge.
The community of Belton, Missouri seeks answers after two young women, Kara Kopetsky and Jessica Runions, disappeared a decade apart.
After eight members of one family were killed in their homes in a single night, residents of the devastated Ohio community were left wondering if they might be next.
Examining the murder of Kendal Fenwick, a 24-year-old single father in Baltimore, Maryland.
Step into fear as Pittsburgh detectives hunt a brutal killer whose late night attacks leave the city gripped by terror.
A look at the top five most shocking fights on the show, moments that sent the court into chaos.
From frightening outbursts to furious judges, Court Cam gives viewers an in-depth examination of some of the most stunning and emotional courtroom moments caught on camera.
The judge must excuse the jury after an accused double-murderer goes on a rant; a DUI defendant won't listen to her lawyer; a laundromat vandal tries to suck up to the judge.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A judge sends a potty-mouthed defendant to jail; a violent convict shows up for sentencing high on multiple drugs; an angry mum rips into her son's confessed killer; and more.
Two teenage former best friends face off in court. A cold-blooded murderer addresses the family of his victim. A judge says the wrong thing at the wrong time to the wrong person.
A teenage defendant faces the wrath of a furious judge; a notorious killer breaks down in court; a defiant judge refuses to let COVID-19 disrupt business as usual.
An online pimple popper is accused of in-court drug use; a judge mutes a foulmouthed murderer; a woman stabs her husband 14 times before calling 911.

A judge has harsh words for a man arrested for throwing his iguana at a restaurant manager; a man accused of domestic violence goes to jail after violating a no-contact order by showing up to court with his alleged victim; and more.

The judge gives a 79-year-old woman a final warning: stop feeding feral cats or go to jail; a local attorney makes a scene outside the courthouse; a defendant angers the judge by appearing for virtual court wearing facial cream.
A shocking turn of events in a murder trial, a mother confronts the woman who stole her baby, and a grieving widow screams at the man who killed her husband.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. An accused burglar keeps falling asleep during his virtual hearing. A judge has no time for Sovereign Citizen tactics. And a drunk school bus driver shows up impaired for his plea hearing.

A convicted woman flees the courtroom after being sentenced to jail time; a grieving man confronts the convict who killed his son in prison; the judge is hard on a carnival worker who's behind on her child support payments; and more.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A judge gets temporarily suspended after making a teenager wear handcuffs and prison garb after falling asleep in court; a man arrested for stalking hurls insults at the prosecutor.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A man convicted of murder gets into a shouting match with the victim's mother; the judge holds a defendant in contempt 3 times after he yells at her during an online hearing.

A defendant is held in contempt after dropping an f-bomb in the courtroom; an elderly woman takes her son to court for withholding her late husband's ashes; a grieving widow has harsh words for the owners of the dogs who killed her husband; and more.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A man drives a car off a cliff trying to elude police; a waitress gets flirtatious with deputies; a shopper refuses to leave a store until she gets a price reduction; and more!

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a woman poops in the middle of the road during a traffic stop; a fugitive gets stuck in a chimney while hiding from police; a woman crashes her car into her own house; and more!

A look at some of the strangest moments of intoxicated arrestees from across the country: a drunk woman evades police on a motorised suitcase; a tipsy man rides his horse and buggy; an intoxicated woman crashes her car into her own house; and more!

Police found the nude bodies of three women shot dead and abandoned in secluded areas outside Daytona Beach. A serial killer was on the loose. The case went cold for nearly a decade until the discovery of a 4th female victim yielded forensic DNA.
Maryland paramedics rush to the scene of a single-vehicle accident and find 20-year-old Brian Moses behind the wheel with multiple stab wounds.
The latest in a string of brazen robberies leaves a beloved, retired sheriff's deputy brutally gunned down, and a survivor of the assault terrified.
After a Valentine's dance, 17-year-old Carla Walker is abducted. Decades later, DNA evidence helps finally crack the case.
Yaser Said breaks his silence about the night he fatally shot his teenage daughters near Dallas, Texas, the events leading up to the tragedy, and how he managed to evade capture for over a decade.

Suspected of a crime he knows nothing about, Andrew Malkinson agrees to help the police clear up the confusion. Convicted in 2004, Andrew never stopped protesting his innocence. Explore the case that continues to spark debate.

When a teacher's deviant messages to a minor surface, Detective Godwin pushes to uncover the extent of his crimes. Then, a predator's warped idea of love triggers a dramatic takedown. Detectives snare a predator who wants both boys and girls.

A man wanted for robbery and carjacking leads sheriff's deputies on a chase through crowded city streets. Police get in a foot chase with an attempted murder suspect. A late-night, 145-mile-an-hour motorway pursuit, and more.

Engaging in a deadly gun battle at the end of a high-speed pursuit; tracking down a car thief who's attempting a water escape in a stolen kayak; outwitting a fugitive driving recklessly on a motorcycle.
Renowned Christian scholar Rick Renner delves into the Greek New Testament, blending historical texts with modern illustrations to unpack God's message for His believers.
Pastor Shawn Baker challenges any and all to get closer to God and to learn how to embrace the life that He has prepared for every single person.
Bible teaching with an emphasis on prophecy, Israel and the Jewish roots of Christianity.
Stories of life, love, and hope from the mission fields of Haiti.
A religious programme fronted by Reverend Samuel Rodriguez.
The worldwide ministry of Rod Parsley and his work to revive the life of God in human hearts.
Joni and guests tackle a wide range of relevant issues, controversial subjects and hard-hitting news topics with candour and wit.

Don't settle for an average life of faith. Discover the power of the Holy Spirit as Marcus Lamb takes you deeper into the Word of God with insightful teaching and personal stories that will challenge and inspire your daily walk.
Col Tim Moore, director of Lamb and Lion Ministries, looks to national and international events.
Messianic rabbi KA Schneider looks at how the Old and New Testaments are integrated, building faith and changing lives.
Rabbi Jonathan Bernis of Jewish Voice Ministries shares the lessons he learned after his miraculous health recovery.
Kenneth Copeland Ministries is a teaching ministry assigned by God to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ all around the world and without compromise in order to get the message out that Jesus is Lord.
Equipping Pastors, group leaders and church members with biblical truth and tools to heal themselves and take healing to a wounded world.
Familiar hymns and beautifully produced original music accompany Scripture to help you let go and surrender during a time of daily prayer and meditation.
Host Nancy Dufresne shares messages addressing the topics of faith, healing, renewing the mind, following the Holy Spirit and a life in Christ.
A church service including praise and worship and an inspiring message by Pastor Mac Hammond.
Documenting the adventurous lives of young missionaries Tim Scott and Will Decker, as they travel to various areas around the world.
Educating children by teaching them Bible stories that highlight important character traits.
Pastor Doug, Dusty, Amelia and characters learn about the Bible and how it applies to daily life with the help of games, songs and silly puppets.

Doug welcomes a lost puppy into his new home, but young Dusty still has some learning to do. After a major mess-up in the garden, Dusty worries Doug won't love him any more and considers running away.
Cowboy Dan teaches children some valuable life lessons.
This animated Gospel-centred series follows a group of student owls as they adventure along creatively learning about nature, faith, and God.
Heroes and heroines of Christian faith, both Biblical and contemporary.
The Scaly Adventures Crew journeys the world in search of amazing animals and incredible adventures.
Author, speaker, and mentor, Drenda Keesee wants you and your family to find happiness, live spiritually whole and prosper emotionally.

Chris Mitchell reports from one of the most explosive regions in the world. Offers a biblical and prophetic perspective to the daily news events that shape our world, with a particular focus on Israel and the Middle East.
Israel Now News is a weekly TV news magazine. It presents a unique perspective of Israel's current events, politics, and culture to an English-speaking audience.
Focusing on a different location each week in the modern State of Israel and showing its relevance as a tourist site while highlighting its significance in the Bible.
Equipping nations to walk in the supernatural power of God and empowering Christians to operate in miracles, signs and wonders, while learning to see world events through the eyes of scripture.

David Dickinson is joined by Debbie Serpell, Stewart Hofgartner, David Tupman and Karen Dalmeny in Gloucester. A lovely old-fashioned clock turns up on Karen's table, Debbie comes face-to-face with a real bargain hunter and who would have thought that six spoons could cause such a reaction!

David Dickinson and his team travel to Colwyn Bay, where Karen Dalmeny is desperate to own a bust that's head and shoulders above the rest. A collection of automobile Dinky toys revs up the den, as does a gold Georgian brooch.

David Dickinson is joined by antiques dealers to appraise items brought in by members of the public. Among the items under scrutiny are a Lowry print, artefacts and timbers relating to HMS Victory and a vinaigrette.

David Dickinson and antique dealers Ian Towning, Alison Chapman, James Layte and Tony Geering are in Coalville in Leicestershire, where items of interest include a set of Georgian silver spoons, a naval percussion pistol and an Indian brooch.

The location is Melton Mowbray today for David Dickinson and his dealers James Layte, Tony Geering, Cheryl Hakeney and Ian Towning, where items of interest include African prints, a silver mustard pot and box and a set of top secret World War II documents.

Angry over his father's dismissal of the consultant hired to help increase their sales, Seth goes MIA, leaving the store in the lurch. When he doesn't come back, Les goes looking and is shocked at where he finds his son spending his time.

Les is devastated when he suspects Seth of doing deals behind his back with a competitor, Ashley gets spooked by a skeleton rock band, Bobby J tosses the pigskin for a big win, and a vintage Dick Tracy radio pops up.

Les and Ashley get reeled in by the world's largest fishing lure, but Seth thinks it will be a tough sell. Things get physical when Byron is pushed too far and Les squares off with a hot headed hillbilly.

David Dickinson and his team of dealers are in Carlisle today where Helen Gardiner tries to fathom out the purpose of a huge bronze table-piece, Stewart Hofgartner is keen to buy an out-of-fashion smoker's cabinet and Tim Hogarth is bewildered when he is presented with a case of wine.

David Dickinson is in Liverpool's Anglican Cathedral to celebrate the 1.5 million pounds the public have taken in cash since the antiques show began, he recalls some of the best auction results, biggest bargains and the boldest sellers ever to visit the Dealers' Den.
Skipton is the location today for David Dickinson and his dealers Henry Nicholls, Cheryl Hakeney, Tony Geering and Jo Brayshaw. A carved shell cameo gets the money rolling in at auction.

David Dickinson and his dealers are at Ludlow in Shropshire today, where Corrie Jeffery has a laugh with a seller who brings in an eastern style vase, David Hackney takes a gamble on a vintage horse racing game and one seller nets a large sum for her charm bracelet.
Blackburn plays host to David Dickinson and his team of dealers as Mark Stevens goes head-to-head with a particularly savvy seller over a Georgian sugar caster.

David Dickinson is in Liverpool with dealers Henry Nicholls, Alison Chapman, Tony Geering and Cheryl Hakeney, where a plaque of the Duke of Wellington turns up at Henry's table and a limited edition Royal Doulton jug gets Alison very excited.

David Dickinson is in Stockport with dealers Simon Schneider, Karen Dalmeny, David Hakeney and Brenda Haller. Brenda is desperate to pin down a deal for an antique gold brooch while Karen plays host to a teddy bears' picnic.

David Dickinson and his team of dealers visit Liverpool Cathedral, where some girls give Henry Nicholls a run for his money, some photos land on Cheryl Hakeney's table and will Tony Geering let a 1930s cocktail shaker go to auction?
Four containers go up for auction after missing holiday deadlines. A can of vintage nostalgia has Matt salivating and Team Muscle turns into Team Softy.
A container riddled with bullets, a burned-out box and a freak accident put everyone on edge, until an out-of-this-world discovery leads to the biggest win yet.
Rival bidders bet large sums on forfeited international shipping containers.
Matt buys a container full of liquor early on and then drives up prices for everyone else, while Uzi and Schlomi bid on a container with World War II antiques.
A new auctioneer irritates Uzi and Schlomi, and Matt battles for a container of hunting equipment.
Uzi and Shlomi set out to destroy the competition at the port of Los Angeles, Uzi drives up prices, and Shlomi bids on a mysterious container from China.
Matt bets his entire wallet on a container he thinks can make him rich, and winds up the butt of the joke.
Uzi and Schlomi gamble in a large auction, and a surprise is hidden in the back of a container.
A mysterious container from the Far East makes landfall in Los Angeles.
A container from Venice, Italy, and a shark-shaped object spark the teams' interest. When the biggest prize is up for grabs, will Team Muscle's rough tactics backfire?
A mysterious container from Guam has the competition ready for battle, and Manic Matt fires a warning shot, but the Israelis aren't backing down.
The mother lode of all containers makes landfall, Jason and Matt go all in, and a surprise twist could change every rule in the book.
Ashley smells weed in the warehouse, and the hunt is on to discover who is getting high at work. Les offers a cash reward for information and Seth plans to drug test the employees.

Les is always on the lookout for deals, but when he hears about a hook-up for truckloads of brand-new goods, he makes a move that could change the store forever. Later, Seth takes a spin on a bar stool racer.

When Seth needs help in the online department, Les volunteers Ashley who immediately oversteps by putting a rare Olympic torch from Seth's personal collection up for sale. When the item goes MIA, all hell breaks loose with the store's reputation.

After tearing through the online department, Ashley has to face the consequences when her rash instruction leads to the destruction of an important shipment. Seth takes a ride in a hovercraft, and Les does business with Muhammad Ali Jr.

When Ashley snags a deal away from Les right under his nose, the family decides to hold a father-daughter sales competition, with Seth as the judge. Bobby J goes for a dangerous ride he won't soon forget.

When Seth has just five minutes to bid on a valuable sports card auction, he takes a shot without telling his Dad. But when the big boss finds out he spent thousands without a word, Les throws down the gauntlet.

After spending a fortune on sports memorabilia, Seth comes down to the wire to sell it all before his Dad's deadline, or else he'll be out thousands of dollars. Plus, Les checks out a sweet Starfire Convertible.
A valuable guitar strikes a special chord in Seth, a customer comes by the shop and tries to buy a fancy watch with some questionable coin and Les does a deal with his doppelgänger.
As she plays for $1 million, an Arizona woman finds out she has two chances to win the top prize when her husband plays the game online.
