Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
Using magic, Holly makes Lucy small enough to play in the Little Kingdom. Lucy has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.
When a new express tunnel opens in Sodor, both Thomas and Diesel want to be the first one through. But their stubbornness may prevent them from enjoying the beautiful spring butterfly migration.
When Carly does not return from saving Emily from an accidental derailing, a worried Sandy recruits the help of a bored Diesel to find her best gal pal.
Dora and Boots take Carmelo's help to fix their friend's running shoes in time for the rainforest race. Dora and Boots rescue Tico from space after his spaceship falls apart.
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Join Tim Rex, brother Tommy, sister Tia, and Triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions! Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes, Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome.

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and go bananas.
Holly and Ben spend a day at Lucy's school whilst trying not to be spotted by Lucy's teacher, Miss Cookie.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.

It's Earth Day and Paddington has the important job of planting a tree. He has to find the perfect spot before it is too late. Baaz holds a spring harvest festival and everyone enjoys bringing their own celebration along.

Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.
It's a busy delivery day for Mailbox and there's a special letter that needs to be delivered, but he doesn't know who it is for. Playing `Blue's Clues' to find out.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.
Naughty Daisy and Poppy magic their teacher, Mrs Fotheringill, to the centre of the Earth, so Granpapa Thistle leads Ben and Holly on a rescue mission.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Josh and Blue must uncover the source of the litter at the park to save Rainbow Puppy's concert.
Farmer hires Willow's pet carnivorous plant to watch over his crops. Papa Smurf prepares a potion to boost his strength, but its effects are heavily altered due to a spider's intrusion.
Rainbows are a pirate's best friend if they're looking for a pot of gold. Captain Squid is hiding treasure though, so Rainbows are this pirate's worst enemy.
There is a new fox cub leader in The Little Kingdom: Nanny Plum. Whilst trying to earn their adventure badges the fox cubs find themselves stuck at the top of a mountain.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming to The Little Kingdom and prepare to welcome him in style.
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.
Ben and Holly want to play with Gaston the ladybird, but he is missing. Nanny Plum uses her magic crystal ball to find him, and discover his daily routine is not what they thought.
When Spongey-Saurus gets wet, he grows; when he dries out, he shrinks; Gabby and Pandy must find a way to keep their new dino-pal the perfect size.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rock slide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

When Eddie and Emmy get impatient at the carnival, they hide in Mayor Humdinger's Humsquatch costume to chase everyone out; Rubble dreams that he meets a ghost and learns that it's not easy to help a ghost make new friends.
The elves give the King some chickens from the Elf Farm so that he can have eggs whenever he likes.
Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.
The naughty toddlers cause chaos during a trip to the big museum.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Jonathan and Judy can't agree on what to do. The Browns come back from a beach trip.
Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties, Katie and the pups rescue the town; Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses.

Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry sending her down Jake's Mountain.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.

Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise! The children think of ideas for names beginning with 'R.'
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Blaze and AJ are joining the police department. With the help of their new police pal, Officer Anna, Blaze transforms into a superfast police car to lend a helping hand, or tire, to any truck in trouble.

Josh and Blue are serving up ice cream on a hot, summer day, but there's just one problem: everyone is gone; while playing Blue's Clues to figure it out, viewers help Jingles the ice cream truck and even learn how to make ice cream.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.
Thaddäus verbringt einen Tag im Waschsalon. SpongeBob und Patrick suchen ein Wurmschwein.

SpongeBob entsorgt in der Stadt den ganzen Abfall, bis auf einen sturen Müll-Ball // SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs versuchen in Perlas Schule Krabbenburger zu servieren, ohne von der strengen Küchenchefin erwischt zu werden.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.
SpongeBob und Patrick suchen Thaddäus, nachdem sich sein Haus in einen Müllberg verwandelt hat.

SpongeBob kommt in den Besitz eines Zauberstabs und verursacht damit versehentlich überall, wo er hingeht, magisches Chaos. Am Freitag, dem 13., wird Mr. Krabs' extreme Abergläubigkeit für alle um ihn herum zur Belastung.
SpongeBob hat einen neuen Freund, der ein gigantischer Hamster ist. Niemand sonst kann ihn sehen.

1. Geschichte: Ein Übersetzungs-Halsband ermöglicht es Garry mit den Anderen zu sprechen und er hat viel zu erzählen! Thaddäus hat jedoch schnell genug von Garys Geschwätz. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob bekommt Mitleid mit einem Clown, der aus dem Zirkus geworfen wurde und nimmt ihn bei sich auf.

Zu Thaddäus' Freude ziehen SpongeBob und Patrick weg, da sie glauben, dass ihre Häuser verkauft wurden. SpongeBobs Glückskekse erlauben einen Einblick in die Zukunft. Plankton nutzt das als Teil eines üblen Plans und gibt Fälschungen heraus.
SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs wollen gefrorene Krabbenburger verkaufen und lassen sich von einem Werbefachmann dazu beraten.

In der Krossen Krabbe tauchen immer wieder anonyme Mitteilungen am Anschlagbrett auf, die unter den Angestellten für Unmut sorgen. Diese Nachrichten führen zu Verwirrung und Misstrauen unter den Mitarbeiter:innen. Die harmonische Arbeitsatmosphäre wird dadurch erheblich gestört.
Um zu einer Food-Messe zu kommen, muss die Krosse Crew sich in der Wildnis durchschlagen. SpongeBob muss den Schein wahren, als ihn ein Brieffreund besucht, den er vorher angeschwindelt hat.

Gary muss die Geheimformel vor Plankton beschützen, die SpongeBob in seinem Haus versteckt hat. Sandy muss alle Einwohner der Stadt retten, als diese durch ein Missgeschick so dumm wie Patrick werden.

Ein heftiger Sturm führt dazu, dass die Krosse Krabbe ins Meer gespült wird, woraufhin Mr. Krabs schnell die Kontrolle übernimmt. Als neuer Kapitän steuert er das schwimmende Restaurant durch die Wellen. Die Krosse Krabbe beginnt ein neues Kapitel auf hoher See mit Mr. Krabs am Ruder.
In der Krossen Krabbe findet ein Talentwettbewerb statt und Thaddäus übernimmt die Planung.

Blaze hat dieses Mal mit gleich drei Eiscreme-Notfällen zu tun. Dafür muss er sich in gleich drei Maschinen verwandeln. So ist er einmal als Eiswagen-Hubschrauber unterwegs und die anderen Male als Eiswagen-U-Boot und Eiswagen-Weltall-Rakete.
Dora macht sich auf den Weg, die Farben des Regenbogens zu finden, denn die Zwillinge freuen sich.

Als SpongeBob und Patrick feststellen, dass sich die Camp-Monster zu zivilisiert verhalten, ermutigen sie sie, das zu ändern. Als eine archäologische Ausgrabung eskaliert, hat Sandy mit dem Rest von Kamp Koral noch ein Hühnchen zu rupfen.

Karen erzählt von der Geschichte eines Strebers, der versucht, eine Actionfigur von seinen drei kleinen Nachbarn zu stehlen. Währenddessen ist Thaddäus damit beschäftigt, einen "Wir Hassen SpongeBob"-Klub zu veranstalten.

SpongeBob und Thaddäus versuchen die Krabbenburger aus einem Imbisswagen heraus in den dunkelsten Tiefen des Ozeans zu verkaufen. Währenddessen verbringen Pearl und Narlene Zeit in der Großstadt zur Feier des Tags des Wals.

Lil's liebster Bubble-Tea-Laden schließt! Die Kinder wollen das Geschäft mit Limetten ausstatten, müssen aber bald Canyon Valley retten. Lil und Min erkennen beide, wie sehr sie ihrer Mutter ähneln, und versuchen, sich von ihr abzugrenzen.

Jack wird zum ersten Mal eingeladen, bei seinem Freund Beef zu übernachten. Jedoch macht sich Jack Gedanken darüber, welchen Eindruck er hinterlassen wird. Jack und Lil wollen beweisen, dass sie echte Valley-Bewohner sind.

Schere hilft Papier dabei, ein spannendes Wochenende zu planen, welches Bleistift beeindruckt. Stein kauft sich einen Hut. Schere, Stein und Papier wollen unbedingt beweisen, dass sie nicht durch Plastik ersetzt werden sollten.

Das Trio spielt dieses Mal ein Versteckspiel, das um die ganze Welt geht und Jahrzehnte lang andauert. Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen den Vermieter dazu zu bringen, ihre Miete zu senken. Dafür wollen sie ihm mit seinem Traum helfen.

Als Luan Grouse einen Streich mit einem falschen Lottoschein spielt, muss sie die Konsequenzen ihres Einkaufverhaltens tragen. Lynn versucht verzweifelt, Basketballschuhe einer beliebten Marke zu finden, weil sie vorher kein Paar kaufen konnte.

Um keine Hausarbeiten machen zu müssen, benutzt Lincoln Lisas Hologrammgerät. Es sieht so aus, als würde er alles erledigen. Weil Mom bei der Arbeit ist, müssen sich die Loud-Geschwister um Dad kümmern, der wegen einer Erkältung im Bett liegt.

Stella hütet das Haus der Direktorin und lädt ihre Freunde heimlich zu einer Poolparty ein. Doch das Unterfangen ist riskant. Gleichzeitig entbrennt zwischen Luna und Luan ein harter Konkurrenzkampf um ein Künstler-Stipendium.
Im Camp Mastodon müssen Lincoln und Clyde gegen die härtesten Jungs im Kampf antreten.
Sandy und SpongeBob sind im Kampfsportfieber, was sich negativ auf SpongeBobs Arbeit auswirkt.

In der Krossen Krabbe wird ein Spielautomat aufgestellt. Mit einem Kran soll man ein Tier greifen. Thaddäus verspielt sein Geld dabei, denn es ist gar nicht so einfach, den Kran zu bedienen. Also hilft SpongeBob und gibt ihm Nachhilfe.

SpongeBob soll auf der Karateinsel zum König des Karate gekürt werden. Er erzählt Sandy die Neuigkeiten, doch diese findet das merkwürdig, da sie selbst viel besser kämpft. Trotzdem reist sie mit SpongeBob auf die Insel.

SpongeBob will dicke Muskeln haben, scheut aber hartes Training. Also bestellt er aufblasbare Arm-Attrappen und gibt damit gehörig in Bikini Bottom an. Beim Anker-Weitwurf-Wettbewerb fällt sein Schwindel schließlich auf.

Die Bewohner von Bikini Bottom starten ein großes Schlittenrennen zum Süd-Pol, und wer gewinnt, wird mit einer Million Dollar belohnt. Natürlich wollen alle gewinnen und reich werden, allerdings ist keinem bewusst, dass Plankton dahintersteckt.

SpongeBob und Patrick haben ihren Mund mal wieder ganz schön voll genommen. Und nun müssen sie zeigen, was sie tatsächlich drauf haben. Die beiden treten den "Drastischen Draufgängern" bei - einer Gruppe von Extremsportlern.
SpongeBob wird als Koch in der Profiliga angeworben, doch er muss zuerst sein Können beweisen.

Nachdem Chloes Eltern keine Geburtstagsparty für sie schmeißen können, geraten Max und Phoebe in einen Wettstreit darum, wer ihr eine neue Party organisiert. Doch als Max' Geschenk in falsche Hände fällt, muss er sich mit Phoebe zusammentun.
Phoebe und Max erzählen sich Geschichten, um beim Thundermans Story Slam zu gewinnen.

Schere, Stein und Papier wollen beweisen, dass sie besser sind als ein weiteres gleichnamiges Trio. Stein und Papiere versuchen gemeinsam, einen Streit zwischen Schere und einer Magierin zu schlichten, bevor die Magie ihr Leben zerstört.

Papier befürchtet, dass Bleistift zu viel Angst haben wird, wenn sie einen Horrorfilm anschauen. Stein und Schere müssen Papier schnell helfen, denn ein leichter Wind weht und Papier ist noch auf der Straße. Die beiden müssen ihn retten.

Patrick entdeckt Vater-Privilegien und tritt bei der Vaterwahl gegen Cecil an. Mit gegensätzlichen Spots werben beide um die Gunst der Wähler und messen sich in Grillduell und Modenschau. Am Ende fällt die Entscheidung, wer der beste Vater ist.

Pinky ist davon überzeugt, dass JJs neue Lederjacke bedeutet, dass ihre wöchentlichen Rollenspiele vorbei sind - und damit auch ihre Freundschaft! // Um das Verbrechen des Jahrhunderts zu lösen, hilft Pinky Bob dabei, undercover zu gehen.

Weil sein Bruder Lance über dem Restaurant ein Fitnessstudio aufbauen will, wird es für Dad schwierig, die Tafel von Lynn zu managen. Lola wird über alle Geschehnisse in der Schule informiert und soll daher eine Klatschkolumne starten.

Das Video der Mondziegen hat 10.000 Aufrufe erreicht und um das zu feiern, wollen sie sich ein Tattoo stechen lassen. Bei einer Spendenaktion von Lisas Wissenschaftsclub fehlt es ihr an den nötigen Verkaufskünsten.

Um Lori zu helfen, besorgt ihr Luan einen Job im Bohnen-Café, dessen Chefin Luan ist. Lana wird derweil von Lily verfolgt. Sie schafft es nicht, ihre kleine Schwester loszuwerden, die ihr überallhin wie ein Schatten folgt.

B.Ö.S.E. fordert diesmal SpongeBob heraus, eine Lieferung innerhalb von zehn Minuten in ihr Versteck zu bringen. Mr. Krabs steckt in Pearls neuem Boot fest. Er muss so tun, als sei er der Motor, um nicht entdeckt zu werden.
Thaddäus und Plankton betreten die Bühne, um einen gemeinsamen Widersacher zu bezwingen. Um den Ozean möglichst ganz nah zu erleben, tauscht Sandy ihre eigenen Gene mit einem Fisch.

Mit Mumblins Hilfe reisen Max und die Halbritter in die Vergangenheit, um zu verhindern, dass Königin Nerelias Amulett in die Hände von Torins Bösling fällt. Doch als Max die Vergangenheit erfolgreich verändert, erschafft sie eine neue Zukunft.

Thaddäus verärgert die Müllwerker, die daraufhin seinen Müll in sein Haus kippen. Das gesamte Haus ist mit Abfall überfüllt. Thaddäus geht darin verloren, und SpongeBob und Patrick begeben sich auf eine abenteuerliche Suche nach ihm.

Arnold verstößt beim Basketballspielen gegen die Regeln und muss auf die Reservebank. Arnold wird von Harold verprügelt. Frankie kommt ihm zu Hilfe. Doch er verlangt eine Gegenleistung: Arnold soll Frankies Motorradgang bei einem Einbruch helfen.

Arnold trifft in der U-Bahn auf merkwürdige Gestalten. Arnold und seine Freunde sind auf der Suche nach dem Schatz des keuchenden Ed. Dieser soll auf der Elchinsel vergraben sein. Doch als sie die Insel erreichen, wartet eine Überraschung auf sie.

Arnolds Mitschüler Torvald geht mit 13 Jahren noch immer in die vierte Klasse. Arnold soll ihm Nachhilfeunterricht in Mathematik geben - doch Torvald scheint ein hoffnungsloser Fall zu sein. Gerald will bei Arnold in der Pension übernachten. Doch Arnold fühlt sich nicht wohl bei dem Gedanken, Gerald seinen exzentrischen Pensionsbewohnern vorzustellen.
Fabian and Patricia tell Alfie the truth when he attacks Mrs Andrews, believing her to be an alien. Meanwhile, Sarah informs Nina that the house whispers.
While Amber decides to compete against Mara in the school elections, Alfie returns to the cellar alone to prove himself.
Victor tracks down Sarah, and Alfie remembers the teachers' spooky ritual from the cellar. The next clue is discovered too.
More is revealed about Victor and Sarah's childhood together, before Sarah visits Nina in a dream to say goodbye.

Henry is trapped at home with his family while Captain Man heads out alone to save the founder of TwitFlash. Meanwhile, Charlotte and Schwoz put together a mystery that could change the world forever.

After a criminal steals Kid Danger's superpower and learns his secret identity, goons are sent to Henry's house to attack; while Henry and Ray fight to protect Henry's family, Jasper, Charlotte and Schwoz work to get his power back.

Taylor and her friends meet Faraz, an old friend of Uncle Charlie, who has discovered the Fountain of Youth. The group attempt to find out if it is connected with Uncle Charlie's mysterious disappearance.
Taylor helps a teenage girl who arrives on the shore claiming she has no memory, leading him and his friends on a mission to discover the girl's true identity before anyone else can.
The Marsupilamis are great at making music, and when a music producer hears it Jade says it was her. Lalou's cat adoption day doesn't go smoothly, when Punch is adopted by mistake.
Dreamer uses all of romance's greatest clichés to bring together two very unlikely Smurfs: Papa Smurf and Willow.
Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.
When the Smurfs recruit a new fire brigade, Clumsy and Dimwitty disguise themselves to take part.
Handy has invented a machine that enables him to understand animals. Clumsy and Dimwitty inadvertently open a portal to other worlds.
SpongeBob breaks his precious alarm clock. Then Karen quickly learns that kids grow up too fast after her new child arrives in the mail.
Patrick discovers that the rock he lives under is actually a sea turtle that overslept; old Man Jenkins disrupts business as usual at the Krusty Krab, but Mr. Krabs can't find a way to kick him out.

Paper takes the cellphones of Rock and Scissors, so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever. Rock cannot sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he is hard to please.

Franz Roll mistakes Scissors for a dog and adopts him, making Rock jealous of their relationship. Paper dreads his annual family get-together because his family's more accomplished than he is, so he hatches a plan to skip it.
Friends become foes when Captain Dread's crew questions Sonic's loyalties. Then, a battle on the high seas breaks out over possession of the Shard.
The Chaos Council returns to New Yoke City more powerful than ever, forcing the rebels to come out of the shadows and bring a fight to their front door.
DoodleBob bites SpongeBob, transforming him into a WereDoodle; SpongeBob dresses up for Gorilla Suit Day and is mistaken for a real gorilla.
Mrs. Puff sends SpongeBob far away to a driving school in Klopnod; Slappy brings his macabre sensibilities to the Krusty Krab when he's hired there as a server.
Baby Corp has been dismantled, but that doesn't stop Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees; Tim spends one last day with Danny.
With nappies piling up in the Templetons' basement, Boss Baby hatches a plan to break into Baby Corp, kick out his enemies and take his business back.
Max and Phoebe discover that Lazlo Chance may be the evil mastermind and enlist Chloe to help. But when Chloe is torn between her head and her heart, it threatens the entire mission.
In an attempt to investigate a string of robberies, Captain Man gets Henry a spot on his favourite game show.
When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.
When Lily and Jack must unexpectedly sacrifice their own summer plans, it kicks off a new, chaotic normal, starting with a runaway trailer that each insists on saving their own way.

Halmoni falls in love with a customer's dog, and rather than return him, she dog-naps him and goes on the lam. Jack volunteers to run the Groom and Board solo, but when a pet snake causes chaos he must protect the other pets from the jaws of death.
Boss Baby discovers an old Mega Fat initiative called Project Boom that threatens to ruin baby rights everywhere.
After Boss Baby sells Tim's favourite toy at a yard sale, he uses company resources to try and get it back.

Chloe, Jinx, and Booch are designing a new school mascot, but Max and Phoebe's fighting ruins the project. After Chloe expresses her anger toward her siblings, they realize their twin-fighting impacts Chloe in new ways now that they're guardians.
After Phoebe and Max let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet Chloe's. With Hank and Barb away, Max and Phoebe transform into them to help Chloe.
As the Chaos Council searches for the Boscage Prism Shard, Sonic realises there's only one way to stop the robots from destroying the forest: a battle.
To save Captain Dread's crew and recapture the Shard, Sonic will have to do what he does best: act fast. Luckily he has help from an unexpected ally.
The Krusty Krab crew goes to a big concert to sell Krabby patties in the stands. SpongeBob explores the melodious dreamscapes of his sleeping neighbours.
The Krusty Krew builds a boat for their penny-pinching captain. SpongeBob discovers a crazed castaway living in his walls.
A series of mysterious lights appear in the sky over Rock Island, causing Gillian to go missing.
The race is on as Sal and Jasmyn try to solve the final riddle before their mystery opponent. Anika and Oliver try everything and anything to get valuable information at the forest house.
Sal and Anika return to the Hunter House to work with Rex on the mystery. Oliver and Jasmyn finally uncover the identity of their secret enemy.
The Sibunas learn that they must perform the ceremony themselves. A school open day is the perfect opportunity to sneak out. Jerome's double life catches up with him.
The Sibunas make it to the Crypt and begin their ceremony, but Denby's discovered Frobisher has gone. Can Sibuna complete the ceremony before the adults find them?
When a new internet celebrity starts to cause havoc for everyone in Swellview, Captain Man has to body swap with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair and save the day.
The Thumb Buddies return from space and are intent on getting revenge against Captain Man and Kid Danger.
Lydia's Bat Mitzvah is coming up, which means she has the opportunity to throw the biggest party that Mapleview Middle's ever seen.
At a sleepover, Taylor dreams that Uncle Charlie is in danger and trying to contact her. Soon she discovers her friends are sharing the same dream.
At the Rock Island Flea Market, Lila buys Nori a lucky charm, just before the gang head off on an expedition to a seismic monitoring station.

The kids find evidence that could prove Erik's innocence, but someone hacks into Sal's computer and erases the footage. Max realises there is something strange about how his birth parents tracked him down.
Evie's stepmum, Lucia, tries to take her back. The Hunters try to track down info on Lucia and visit Evie's old neighbourhood, where they meet tech-loving Jennie.

The kids find the stolen puzzle box and try to hide it from the police. Erik returns home but is acting suspicious. Daniel finds a clue in the museum footage and after tough goodbyes, Max leaves for Spain.
The Hunters meet a young girl named Evie, and her necklace has the same crown symbol they discovered in the cryptex. Erik reveals that he has a special connection to Evie.

Stuck inside the house due to a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand; Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to help steal desserts from the school kitchen using secret underground tunnels.

Eleanor prepares her signature cake for the big Bake-Off competition and leaves it out to cool; the boys are worried that Dave is going to move the family, so they decide to make the house seem haunted in order to thwart a sale.
Alvin borrows Simon's invisibility suit, but gets trapped when the zip gets stuck. After Theodore makes a wish, the Chipmunks try to learn what it was so they can make it come true.
Jeanette wants to give a toast to Brittany at her party. But Jeanette is so shy, she seeks advice from the most confident person she knows, Alvin. Big mistake.
When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger.
The chipmunks discover Officer Dangus has a twin brother who's a bully and encourage Dangus to stand up to him.
Simon tells Alvin time travel is impossible, until a man from the future shows up at their home.

Simon's experiment of how plants respond to positive or negative feedback creates a monster, and it's growing. Brittany's fear of bees turns into admiration when she's shrunk down to their size and experiences life as a bee.

Jeanette and the Chipmunks orchestrate a break-in at Bocarter's house to rescue a chimpanzee he keeps in a cage. Alvin is alarmed that Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes because he's not that funny.

When Alvin insists on taking over the drums from Theodore, Theodore fights back by stealing Alvin's persona. As Theodore is perfecting a pancake recipe, Alvin plays a trick by pouring burping powder in his next batch.
Dave finds himself in school with Alvin after he discovers that he never graduated from high school; Simon's new friend decides to ditch him to spend time with Alvin.

When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits and her replacement is a nightmare. Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie so The Chipettes release a video of the boys watching, terrified.

Alvin and Brittany get stuck alone at the school with a ghost they think roams the halls. Alvin passes off a rock he found on the ground as a meteor for a science project and gets some unwanted attention.

When an exchange student comes to visit, he tells a scary story that makes the chipmunks think Dave is in danger. Annie and Amber offer to plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor in the process.

When Eleanor discovers there are no female knights, she hides in a suit of armour and enters a knight competition; Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.
Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.

Simon's interactive video game is about to take off, until Jeanette reprograms the game's villain; when Alvin dreams of joining a private club, he volunteers Dave to play squash, even though Dave doesn't play.
Alvin sounds the alarm when he believes Theodore has joined a motorcycle gang of vampires; When Brittany declines Alvin's help for a talent show, he convinces Jeanette to enter, putting them at odds.
The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play, after learning of its curse; Simon's robot Gizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela, until a sudden tragedy reveals Gizmo's true heart.
Eleanor and Jeanette take care of a sick Brittany, and then they wonder if Brittany would care for them if they were sick.

To land the lead role in a play, Alvin wagers Brittany that he can remain in character as a shoe cobbler. When Brittany becomes convinced she's a long-lost princess, she carries her new royal status a little too far.
Coach Dobbins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game. Dave has a problem when each of the Chipettes wants him to be their date to the Father Daughter Dance.

When Miss Miller gets robbed, Eleanor and Theodore promise to find the culprit and bring them to justice. Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she so desperately needs to learn.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.

Alvin bets Bo Carter that alien life exists and only has a week to prove it or suffer embarrassing consequences. Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.

When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat screen TV. they decide to become fugitives on the lam. Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.

Alvin thinks he's losing his mind when Simon goes missing and no one else even remembers who Simon is. When the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall, Alvin worries about the results.

Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school. The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things.

Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

When Brittany is hurt before a major school event, Jeanette fills in as the Principal's assistant. When Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, Alvin enlists Dave's help, locking the families in a heated competition.

The Chipettes set out to prove to Alvin and the boys that being a superhero isn't only a guy thing. Miss Smith tells Alvin that if he doesn't pass the next test, he'll be held back a year and separated from his brothers.

Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty when she gets a rash on her face. Can she practice what she preaches? Alvin thinks that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes. When the girls find out, they try to let Kevin down gently.

The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a student film, but they all have a different movie in mind; The Chipmunks follow Dave and fear that he's fallen in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a wax statue!

Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory; Alvin grows tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by reality TV stars, so he decides to become one himself.
Brittany's style icon proclaims Jeanette is a fashion trendsetter; Theodore thinks that he is a real superhero.
Jeanette signs the Chipmunks and the Chipettes up for a green living competition; Alvin agrees to look after his crush's talking bird.
While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.
Alvin convinces Simon to build him an exact replica of a dangerous toy sports car; Alvin must pass a manners course to prove he is worthy of meeting a princess.
After a fight with Brittany, Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers. Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a big hit.
Thieves jeopardise Arthur's attempt to crack the wine business.
Phoebe is due to give birth, but her cantankerous midwife is a little the worse for wear having had one too many drinks.

Chrissy discovers a very rare plant when she tidies the Roper's overgrown garden with Robin. However, when she plans to use it in an up-coming flower show, Larry gets word that the plant is actually cannabis.
Kenny Everett welcomes Chas & Dave, Terry Wogan and Mel Smith for music, laughter and more.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.

When a vacancy arises for an inspector the crew-men are not keen to apply, fearing that they will end up like Blakey. But needs must in the Butler household as Mum needs a new coat and so Stan takes the vacancy.

The bus staff are given some say in the running of their canteen and Stan is put in charge as manager. He employs Mrs. Sharma as a cook, but she can only make Indian dishes, and so he replaces her with Olive.
Nellie takes Eli along to see The Doctor, only The Doctor is more interested in Nellie's behaviour, than Eli's cough.
After failing a mock exam, the class decides the only way to pass is to cheat.
Jeremy tries to counsel two students who plan to marry without realising that bigamy is illegal in England.
Miss Courtney discovers a party at Jeremy's after he stays home with the flu.
Jeremy offers to aid a Russian sailor who loves an English girl.
Jeremy defends the honour of a French student.
The class finds out that Jeremy spent his childhood in an orphanage.
Students prepare for end-of-term exams; a chance encounter might come back to haunt Mr Brown.

This memorable storyline has Bob and Terry going to extraordinary lengths to avoid hearing a football score before they watch a recording of the match on TV. Interestingly, those other two Geordie lads Ant and Dec made their own version of this particular episode.
Bob thinks Terry needs new friends, but, by inviting him to a trendy dinner party, he also invites disaster. Terry though, finds an unlikely ally in Thelma.
Terry helps Bob move his most treasured possessions from his old house to the new one, but Thelma refuses to have his junk in their home.

Terry is disappointed that Bob has asked someone else to be his best man, but he eventually agrees to go out for a meal with his friend. After a few drinks at the restaurant, they start to chat up a couple of pretty women who are also eating there.
Mrs Chambers has grandiose plans for Thelma's wedding to Bob that leaves the men feeling overwhelmed, so they decide to rebel.
Young Mr Grace has died and the Grace Brothers department store has closed. The former staff attend a reading of his will, and find they have inherited a hotel.
After their first night in their own hotel, the former staff of Grace Brothers are settling into their new roles. However, they still need to come up with money to get the hotel running.
Mrs Slocombe finds herself in court for stealing a horse-drawn cart and Mr Humphries' relationship with Mavis Moulterd continues to develop.
A party of Americans have come to stay at the Millstone Country Hotel for a weekend. It means £1,000 plus tips, so the staff set about bringing the ageing hotel up to scratch.
A photograph for the hotel brochure is planned. Ghostly happenings start at the manor.
Little does the staff realise that it is expected to provide cultural entertainment for a group of American tourists.
Arthur needs to deliver a consignment of videos and borrows a barge, causing strains in the family.
While Loretta takes Jodie back to the UK for her advert shoot, Rob tries to make use of her 5-star room, but the rest of the family have their own plans for its use.

The final series of the show begins. It's a grand occasion as the Chatsworth inhabitants celebrate being awarded an Olympic ring from London 2012. The Maguires toast the expansion of their empire: Mimi's hijacked control of the local school via the PTA and Shane's setting up a new business venture. Business is booming, but the family is thrown into turmoil when Jamie makes a shocking discovery.
Gary takes Michael out in his pram, and they are nearly killed by a bomb. When he awakes in the present day, Gary is horrified to discover that Michael has travelled in time, as well.
Terry is asked to get rid of some squatters, leading Arthur to dream of a future as a property developer.
Hits from one of the biggest pop acts of the 70s, and now back for the 2020s, ABBA. Featuring 32 songs, 9 of which were UK number 1s.
From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s!
Today we'd call it Cheesy Pop! Back then it was Bubblegum Pop & TISWAS Sally has a prime selection including David Cassidy, Mungo Jerry, Lynsey De Paul, Tony Orlando & The Osmonds.
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
Keeping it in the family with 90 minutes of top tunes from the Bee Gees, ABBA, the Osmonds, the Nolans and more.
A music playlist featuring a selection of classic hits spanning the year 1970.
60 minutes of back-to-back 1970 number 1s - from Simon & Garfunkel and Elvis Presley to Lee Marvin and Freda Payne. With Mr Charts himself - Mark Goodier.
Runners-up from the UK charts in 1970: those ten songs that didn't quite make it, including Elvis Presley, 'Canned Heat', Mary Hopkin, 'The Kinks' and 'Deep Purple'.
We're going back to a time when Little Eva was telling everybody to do the loco-motion and The Beatles claimed they were the walrus. Expect to see all of your fave artists as we rewind to the 60s.
Blackburn's your man for the ultimate early 70s party playlist. How about some pure pop cheese from big names & forgotten acts that'll have you singing your head off? Let's bop!
Presenting over 7 hours of songs of the 70s, from disco and punk to ABBA's classics and Queen's anthems.
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
If you love the nightlife, and you gotta boogie, then NOW 70s has a two-hour antidote. Turn up those disco lights and strap on the roller skates! Oh, yeah!
Come prepared, as those vocal cords are going to see a lot of action with three nostalgic hours spent with Pat Sharp's 70s house party. All gatecrashers welcome!
A complete video retrospective of George's '80s hits - both solo and with Wham!, Elton John, Aretha Franklin and that forgotten top 10 from Boogie Box High.
Another episode of the Heritage Chart - new music by heritage acts! With Mike Read.
From the decade that invented the genre - non-stop powerful love songs, back to back.
Three hours, three decades, 33 classics - in order.
A lesson in how to Kiss a Fool, Kiss Him Goodbye, French Kiss in the USA and Kiss with Confidence.
Expect synth pop, soft rock, leg warmers, Lycra and lots of big hair.
Chances are you bought at least one daft single when you were a kid? Andy Crane has unearthed 25 novelty hits from the mid-80s to the mid-90s - none are cool, but all are 100% fun!
Amazingly, every one of these 23 top tunes only spent 7 days at the top of the UK chart during the 1980s - even big songs by superstars like Madonna, Kylie, Blondie & U2!
It's the weekend, and we're showing out! Classic pop that has stood the test of time.
The 70s and 80s were full of edible bands and songs, and TV chef Rustie Lee has raided the fridge and pantry to serve up pop's sweet treats. It is going to be a riot.
From Aylesbury to Woking via Godalming and the Isle of Wight, where do your favourite '80s acts come from? We reveal all!
New to the NOW 70s archive - another 25 long forgotten pop classics. Including Boney M, Hall and Oates, Smokie and Dollar.
Lesser known songs you may have forgotten from artists you'll certainly know!
25 step-tacular 80s videos that are famous for their dancing, most of them brilliant, some of them just a little bit dodgy. Presented by those move-some five-some Steps!
These are the 30 biggest synth-pop and electronic tracks from the decade that invented the genre! With Gary Numan, Yazoo, Pet Shop Boys, Soft Cell, Visage and Duran Duran.
Before the CD, the perfect pop songs were spun by singers and bands on 7 inch vinyl. From 1980-1984 these were the classic UK hits that invaded the world!
He's sung and played bass with many over the years, but fame came as one of the original Sex Pistols in 1976. Currently with Blondie, Glen picks his 25 punk and new wave favourites.
Sing-along classics and rock party anthems all night long. Crazy, Crazy, Crazy party nights featuring KISS, Queen, Meatloaf, Kaiser Chiefs and Foo Fighters to name just a few!
Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger and everyone brought riffs, anthems and questionable hair!
We open the high school year book with Weezer in 1995 and remember the amazing bands that rocked every school party through to 2005!
25 of the greatest rock bands of the noughties featuring Paramore, Bullet For My Valentine, Slipknot and My Chemical Romance.
Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!
Claire Sturgess relives her 50 greatest heroes with the rock music that defined the 00s! Blink, MCR, Razorlight and Kings of Leon are all in the top 10 - but who's at number 1?
Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems, featuring Kings of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro, and the Foo Fighters.
Claire has 30 of her best alternative rock bands and artists who side-stepped classic rock to include influences from Punk, Funk, Goth, Indie and even Hip Hop.
Turn up your speakers to 11 and live life even louder. Emo Anthems in order from Linkin Park in 2000 to The My Chemical Romance at the end of the decade in 2010.
Alex Baker brings his 50 biggest 00s anthems! Expect everything from Green Day and Muse to Linkin Park and the Arctic Monkeys, with the tunes getting bigger and bigger as he goes!
The most iconic and ear-shattering rock songs that shaped the genre! Including Led Zeppelin's timeless Whole Lotta Love and AC/DC's rebellious Highway to Hell. Crank it up and enjoy!
Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.
Nicky Horne presents his favourite 30 rock party anthems of all time, featuring Led Zeppelin, Def Leppard, Thin Lizzy and David Bowie.
Die große News-Show! Mit allen Themen des Tages, Breaking News, Wetter und Society.
Wolfgang Fellner unterhält sich in Interviews mit Gästen über aktuelle Ereignisse.
Die Talkshow beschäftigt sich mit den spannendsten und wichtigsten Ereignissen des Tages.

Thomas' Taten belasten Elizabeth. Sie steht unter Hausarrest und muss sich beim Verhör durch Lord Dudley rehabilitieren. Lord Somerset muss sich nach den Taten seines Bruders dem wütenden Kronrat und dem erschütterten König stellen.

Mit dem neuen Lord Protektor ist eine neue Zeit angebrochen. Edward, vom Einfluss seines Onkels Somerset befreit, ist ermutigt, noch rücksichtslosere protestantische Reformen durchzusetzen und neue Bündnispartner zu suchen.

Als der König erkrankt, sieht der Hof die Chance, von einem Katholiken angeführt zu werden, während Mary nach Whitehall reitet. Die Menschen haben allerdings die Katholiken zum Feind erklärt. Wegen ihres Bruders sind Mary und Elizabeth kurz vereint.
Eine Burleske-Tänzerin könnte mit dem Tod von Männern zu tun haben, die Lippenstiftspuren zeigen.
Murdoch und Crabtree geben vor, dass ein ermordeter Zeuge noch lebt, um seinen Mörder zu fassen.

Der britische Musiker Cliff Richard galt in den sechziger Jahren als die englische Antwort auf Elvis Presley, eroberte mit Rock 'n' Roll, Beat und Schlagern über Jahrzehnte immer neue Fangruppen. 1970 kam er nach Berlin. Der Filmemacher Dieter Finnern zeichnete eine Bühnenshow von Cliff Richard auf, filmte ihn aber auch vor dem Hintergrund Berlins, beim Bummel durch die Stadt, interviewte ihn, beobachtete ihn bei den Proben zur Bühnenshow und konfrontierte ihn mit alten Aufnahmen.

Die Nachricht von der Schwangerschaft treibt Susanne und Christoph in ein Chaos der Gefühle. In die anfängliche Euphorie mischen sich Vorbehalte. Jonas versucht nach einem Besuch von Marie, das Umgangsrecht für die Zwillinge zu bekommen.

Kommissar Hansen hat in einer Vernehmung den Entführer Silvano Eminescu dazu gebracht, ihm zu verraten, wo der kleine Junge, den Eminescu entführt hat, versteckt ist. Der Junge wurde gerettet. In den Zeitungen wird Hansen als Held gefeiert. Jetzt behauptet Eminescu, er sei von Hansen tatkräftig zur Aussage gezwungen worden und will ihn verklagen. Hansen bestreitet die Tat. Gudrun geht den ersten Spuren nach, während Yasmin ihren Mann, Eminescus Pflichtverteidiger, ausfragt.

Isa von Brede übernimmt die Vertretung von Lothar Paulsen. Der Sohn des pensionierten Berufssoldaten kam bei einem Einsatz in Afghanistan ums Leben. Nun will Paulsen die Bundeswehr verklagen. Markus Gellert vertritt die Interessen des Schauspielers Johannes von Gülden. Seit 20 Jahren spielt dieser in einem Theater eine feste Rolle, jetzt soll ein jüngerer Darsteller seine Nachfolge antreten und von Gülden steht ohne Einkommen da.

Mascha Hillinger und Karin Berger übernehmen die Leitung im Hotel Heidelberg. Während die international erfahrene Hotelmanagerin Karin auf maximale Effizienz setzt, will Mascha die gutbürgerliche Hotelküche komplett auf vegan umstellen.

Sekretärin Klara Degen wehrt sich energetisch, wenn ihr Chef die Festanstellung von Klaras körperlicher Zuwendung abhängig macht. Wenig später findet sie ihren Chef tot im Büro, und es dauert nicht lange, da steht die Polizei vor ihrer Haustür.

Klara Degen hat im Polizeirevier die Schwangerschaftsvertretung der Abteilungssekretärin übernommen. Die neue, aufregende Arbeit gefällt ihr. In der Nacht hat eine anonyme Anruferin den Mord an einer Frau angezeigt. Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert und seine Kollegen haben in der Wohnung von Corinna Becker zwei gepackte Koffer, einen wenig freundlichen Abschiedsbrief an ihren Mann Eugen und Blutspuren gefunden. Im Verhör beteuert Eugen Becker seine Unschuld. Er bricht sogar in Tränen aus.

Klara Degen feiert zusammen mit ihrer Schwester Sylvia und deren Tochter Lena ausgelassen die Walpurgisnacht auf dem Hexentanzplatz. Auf dem Heimweg findet Lena ein Handy und Klara die dazugehörige Frauenleiche. Anke Simon, so der erste Eindruck, ist an Herzversagen gestorben. Dr. Münster findet jedoch heraus, dass die junge Frau erwürgt wurde. Klaras Neugierde ist geweckt und sie beginnt zu ermitteln.

Als die Fluggesellschaft die Angehörigen zur Trauerfeier einlädt, nehmen auch Thomas Wintersperger und seine Frau Sonja daran teil, um Abschied von ihrer Tochter Anna zu nehmen. Weil er ihr nahe bleiben möchte, kauft Thomas einen heruntergekommenen Krämerladen in der Nähe der Unfallstelle und baut ihn zu einer Kneipe aus. Seine Frau zeigt kein Verständnis dafür. Das Paar geht zunächst getrennte Wege. Langsam belebt die Kneipe den verschlafenen Hafen und bringt Bewegung ins Dorf.

Sie wacht aus einem Albtraum auf, in dem jemand in Gefahr ist. Sie sorgt sich um die Gesundheit ihres Vaters und denkt darüber nach, ihre Arbeit aufzugeben, um ihn zu besuchen. Der Graf erhält einen verdächtigen Anruf und muss abreisen.

Der Sturm ist das große Gesprächsthema. Im Hotel bricht Panik aus, als niemand weiß, wie man den Tresor öffnet, und der Lebensmittelhändler bezahlt werden will. Als Frau Andersen aus dem Krankenhaus zurückkehrt, liest sie einen beunruhigenden Brief.

Nach den tragischen Ereignissen greift Fie Molly Andersen unter die Arme. Morten und Amandas Vater geraten aneinander. Einige Herren wollen das Hotel wechseln, ihre Frauen jedoch sind dagegen. Der Graf trifft sich mit seinem mysteriösen Anrufer.

Der Sommer neigt sich dem Ende zu. Sie wird angeboten, über den Winter zu bleiben, doch sie zögert. Olga sucht noch immer nach einer Frau für ihren Sohn. Sibylle mag ihn sehr, hat aber Skrupel. Derweil erhält der Graf einen neuen Erpressungsbrief.

Amanda Madsen und die anderen Stammgäste aus Kopenhagen sind zurück in Andersens Strandhotel und die nächste Sommersaison ist eröffnet. Doch was ist aus Morten geworden, der unter Mordverdacht von der Polizei geflohen ist?

Scott bestellt Kaffee mit Kuhmilch, Ellen ist offen für neue Teesorten. Einmal die Woche treffen sie sich in einem hippen Café. Die beiden Best Ager sind zwar seit Jahrzehnten verheiratet, leben aber getrennt. Mit einer Paartherapie will Ellen ihre zerbrochene Ehe aufarbeiten. Doch während Scott die Kluft zwischen ihnen schließen möchte, stehen bei ihr die Zeichen auf Trennung. Ellen ist seit Monaten bei den Quäkern und auf dem Weg in ein neues Leben.

Antoine lebt in den Pariser Banlieues und teilt sich seine Zeit zwischen Rap und seinem Job als Lieferant auf. Er trifft durch Zufall auf Madame Loyseau, die Gesangslehrerin an der Pariser Oper ist und in ihm Talent erkennt. Trotz seiner fehlenden Opernkultur ist Antoine von der Musik fasziniert und lässt sich überzeugen, den Unterricht zu besuchen. Er fühlt sich jedoch gezwungen, Freunde und Familie zu belügen, für die das Thema Oper zu weit von ihrer Lebenswirklichkeit entfernt ist.
Geprägt von dem Erlebten ist Elizabeth entschlossen, nicht in dieselben Fallen zu treten, in die sie zuvor in Chelsea geraten war. Doch bald steht ihr eine neue Prüfung bevor.

Monk ist ein frustrierter Romanautor, der keine Lust mehr auf das Establishment hat, das von schwarzer Unterhaltung profitiert, die sich auf müde und beleidigende Metaphern stützt. Infolgedessen beschließt er unter einem Pseudonym ein ausgefallenes Buch zu schreiben. Auf diese Weise wird er immer mehr in das Zentrum der Heuchelei und des Wahnsinns getrieben, das er bisher eigentlich verachtet hat.
The stories of women who helped win World War II, including those who risked their lives flying planes, served as American spies and in the all-African American Central Postal battalion.
Heat in Portland, Ore.; exploring why some urban areas are hotter than others in Medellín, Colombia; a visit to Phoenix -- the hottest city in the U.S.

Positive climate tipping points; a supercomputer in Cheyenne, Wyo., shows how climate systems are predicted and analysed; a Michigan coal plant makes progress in the transition to renewables; climate challenges and vulnerabilities across the U.S.
A remarkable story both of heroism and mankind's failings - and one of the worst atrocities carried out by Germany during the Second World War. (S)

A unique window into a bygone era when a thrilling new invention, the motion picture camera, first captured the nation on film. Offering a rare portrait of a powerful and prosperous nation and Empire on the cusp of great change.

Edwardian Britain was the richest and most powerful country in the world. By looking at footage, this is an exploration into what this meant for the men, women and children hard at work in the mills and the mines.
Vivid colourised footage shows the creation of mass leisure, the suffrage movement, and the beginnings of world war. The Edwardians demanded change, and it came but in a way that few could foresee.

A gun battle between government agents and Branch Davidians leads to one of the longest stand-offs in American history; the story behind the siege features new footage and firsthand accounts from survivors, law enforcement agents and eyewitnesses.
Die Sendung fasst die Höhepunkte und die besten Angebote des Vortages noch einmal zusammen.
Noch einmal werden die Highlights der Woche aus dem Pearl-Sortiment gezeigt.

Winston Churchill weiß, dass die Kontrolle über das Erdöl über Sieg oder Niederlage entscheidet. Dabei hat er den Nahen Osten und den Suezkanal im Blick. Die Achsenmächte sehen das ähnlich. Somit versuchen die Italiener, Ägypten zu erobern.

Nach der verheerenden Niederlage von Stalingrad ist Adolf Hitler entschlossen, alles auf eine Karte zu setzen. Seinem Gegner Josef Stalin soll eine entscheidende Niederlage beigebracht werden, um so die Kontrolle an der Ostfront zurückzugewinnen.

Die USA wollen die Befreiung Europas in Frankreich beginnen. Die Briten befürchten jedoch ein schreckliches Blutbad und plädieren für eine Invasion Siziliens. Dieser Plan setzt sich durch und bereits im Juli beginnt die entsprechende Offensive.

Die Befreiung von Paris im August 1944 markierte einen Wendepunkt im Zweiten Weltkrieg. Nach jahrelanger Besatzung durch die Deutschen stand die Stadt unter Belagerung. Doch mit einer kombinierten Anstrengung von französischem Widerstand, alliierten Truppen und einer Aufstandsbewegung der Pariser Bevölkerung wurde die deutsche Besatzung schließlich besiegt. Die symbolträchtige Befreiung von Paris festigte den Glauben an einen bevorstehenden Sieg über das nationalsozialistische Regime.

Zwei Jahre nach dem Überfall auf Pearl Harbor rückt die US Navy unaufhaltsam auf das japanische Mutterland zu. Um den Krieg rasch und siegreich zu beenden, benötigen die Amerikaner jedoch neue Operationsbasen. Dabei geraten mehrere Inseln ins Visier.
In der Dokumentationsreihe werden Bild- und Filmmaterialien aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg gezeigt.

Gegen Ende des Krieges versuchen die Amerikaner, in größtmöglicher Nähe zu Japan eine Basis zu errichten. Von hier aus sollen ihre neu entwickelte B29-Bomber das Kaiserreich angreifen. Als Ziel nehmen sie die Insel Iwojima ins Visier.

Wasser ist nicht nur zum Trinken da: Zahlreiche Tierarten Asiens tummeln sich auf Nahrungssuche und zur Abkühlung in Seen und Flüssen oder lauern an den Rändern der Gewässer auf Beute. Schmelzwasser und Monsunregen sind gleichermaßen wichtig.

Isolierte Lebensräume, wie die Inseln von Sri Lanka, Indonesien und Japan, sind ein Experimentierkasten der Evolution: Abgetrennt von den Hauptpopulationen entstanden faszinierende Tierarten wie Komodowarane, Sumpfkrokodile und Nasenaffen.

Die Sendung informiert ausführlich über das politische und gesellschaftliche Geschehen in Deutschland, Europa und der Welt. Neben den Übertragungen wichtiger politischer Ereignisse werden in Gesprächen mit Experten aktuelle Debatten analysiert.

Französische Kinder von Wehrmachtssoldaten machen nach Jahrzehnten ihre Geschichten öffentlich. Nach dem Ende des Krieges wurden sie als Deutschen-Bastarde, Boches, beschimpft, ihre eigenen Familien haben sie verstoßen und verachtet.

Aktuelle gesellschaftliche, politische und wirtschaftliche Themen stehen im Mittelpunkt einer vertiefenden Betrachtung. Durch sachliche Reportagen, fundierte Hintergrundberichte und Analysen werden relevante Ereignisse umfassend beleuchtet.

1959 öffnet in Deutschland die erste Diskothek ihre Pforten in Aachen, dann in den 60ern schießen Discos wie Pilze aus dem Boden. Wir erzählen die Geschichte der Diskothek und wie sie das Nachtleben in Ost- und Westdeutschland geprägt hat.

Ohne Punk hätte es die Neue Deutsche Welle nicht gegeben. In Düsseldorf und anderen Städten gründen sich Ende der 1970er zahlreiche Bands. Sie sind provokant und gesellschaftskritisch. "No Future - keine Zukunft" lautet das Schlagwort des Punks.

Die Neue Deutsche Welle nimmt an Fahrt auf und erobert nach der rebellischen Punkphase den Mainstream. Überall gründen sich neue Bands, entstehen Hits auf Deutsch. Ab 1981 wird die Welle immer bunter, beliebter und schließlich zum Massenphänomen.

Im Jahr 1983 dominiert die Neue Deutsche Welle die deutschen Charts. Manche, wie Nena, werden jetzt zu Superstars und produzieren Hits am Fließband. Doch auf den Höhenflug in der Gunst des Publikums folgt schon bald der Überdruss.

Asiens Gebirge wie der Himalaya oder der Karakorum haben eine einzigartige Tierwelt hervorgebracht, die perfekt an die extremen Lebensbedingungen in großer Höhe angepasst ist. Die asiatischen Gebirge zählen zu den extremsten Lebensräumen der Erde.

In der Sendung stellt sich eine Persönlichkeit mit interessanter Vita aus Gesellschaft, Kultur, Wirtschaft oder Politik in einem intensiven Gespräch über Hintergründe, Lebensentwürfe und Erfahrungen den Fragen der Moderatoren.

Die Reihe beleuchtet die besonderen Fähigkeiten und die enge Verbindung zwischen Mensch und Hund. Forschungen und Beobachtungen zeigen Herkunft, Sinne, Verhalten und die erstaunliche Physiologie verschiedener Hunderassen.

Hunde haben eine ausgeprägte emotionale Bindung zum Menschen und ihre außergewöhnlichen Sinne können ihre Besitzer im Alltag unterstützen. Das erklärt auch, wieso und auf welche Weise gerade der Hund ein so gewichtiger Teil im Leben der Menschen ist.

Sie sind die besten Freunde des Menschen seit Tausenden von Jahren - Aber wie viel weiß der Mensch wirklich über den Hund? Gezeigt werden die einzigartigen Eigenschaften von Hunden, ihre Physiologie sowie ihre emotionale Bindung zum Menschen.

Es wird das erste Lebensjahr eines "New-Forest-Ponys" gezeigt. Diese Rasse aus Südengland ist nur in einem Waldgebiet, dem New Forest beheimatet. Neben dem ersten Lebensjahr des Fohlens werden viele seiner wilden Nachbarn gezeigt.

Verschiedene Themen der deutschen und internationalen Zeit- und Kulturgeschichte werden nachgezeichnet. Mit Expertengesprächen und szenischen Nacherzählungen werden dabei Vorkommnisse aus jüngerer und älterer Geschichte neu zum Leben erweckt.

Fast 130.000 alliierte Soldaten stürmten am 6. Juni 1944 die Strände der Normandie. Ziel war die Befreiung Frankreichs von den Nazis. Britische Doppelagenten des MI-5 verfolgten die Mission, die Deutschen von der Normandie fernzuhalten.

Am 10. Juli 1943 landen alliierte Truppen auf Sizilien. Dieser Coup ist das Ergebnis einer falschen Fährte, die die Alliierten mit einem vermeintlich vertrauten Dokument in der Tasche eines toten britischen Soldaten in Spanien gelegt hatten.

Während der Kubakrise im Oktober 1962 hatte die ganze Welt Angst vor einem Atomkrieg. Ein Spion half US-Präsident Kennedy dabei, sich gegen Chruschtschow zu behaupten. Der sowjetische Offizier Oleg Penkovsky leistete hervorragende Arbeit für die CIA.
